query: SELECT a.id, a.workspace_id, a.run_id, a.state, COALESCE(a.ready_key, '') AS "ready_key!", COALESCE(encode(a.checksum_value, 'hex'), '') AS "checksum!" FROM central.artifact_produce_edges pe JOIN central.workflow_nodes n ON n.id = pe.node_id JOIN central.artifacts a ON a.id = pe.artifact_id WHERE n.node_key = $2 AND a.required_role = $3 AND ($1::uuid IS NULL OR pe.run_id = $1::uuid) ORDER BY pe.created_at, pe.id
